description: This file contains extensions to the NodeAppModel class, providing functionalities related to resolving URLs for Canvas and A2UI hosts, URL normalization, UI display management, capability refresh logic, and TCP probing. It appears to be part of an iOS application dealing with network-based UI components in an OpenClaw project.

methods.name: resolveCanvasHostURL
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves the Canvas host URL, ensuring it is not a loopback address and appending the specific path.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostURL
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves the A2UI host URL, similar to the Canvas URL but appends a query parameter for iOS platform.

methods.name: normalizeURLForTrustComparison
methods.description: Normalizes a URL string by lowercasing scheme and host, and removing fragments for trust comparison.

methods.name: showA2UIOnConnectIfNeeded
methods.description: Displays the default A2UI canvas when the device connects, ensuring UI is presented appropriately.

methods.name: ensureA2UIReadyWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Ensures that the A2UI is ready, attempting to refresh capabilities if the initial load fails, with a timeout.

methods.name: showLocalCanvasOnDisconnect
methods.description: Reverts the UI to a default or local canvas upon disconnection.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostURLWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the A2UI host URL and refreshes node capability if necessary.

methods.name: resolveCanvasHostURLWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the Canvas host URL and refreshes node capability if necessary.

methods.name: probeTCP
methods.description: Performs a TCP probe to the URL's host and port to check connectivity within a specified timeout.
